items.title: Angus Taylor reveals shadow ministry elevating Hastie, Nampijinpa Price
items.description: The new Liberal leader has announced his new shadow ministry, elevating prominent right-faction supporters including West Australian MP Andrew Hastie.

items.title: Health insurance costs to jump by biggest rise in almost a decade
items.description: Private health insurance premiums will rise at their fastest rate in almost a decade, after the federal government approved a 4.41 per cent average increase from April.

items.title: Man arrested after fatal Sydney stabbing escaped care days before attack
items.description: A man arrested after a fatal stabbing in Merrylands escaped from mental health care while being transferred between hospitals more than a week ago, health authorities say.

items.title: Acid on skin, eyes gouged out, body discarded. Fresh horrors emerge from Syria
items.description: Victims of Syria's brutal Assad regime were tortured to death in completely horrible and inhumane ways. The relatives of "The Missing" are still searching for them as their numbers continue to explode.

items.title: 'You make your bed, you lie in it': Albanese's warning to 'ISIS brides' in Syria
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese insists the federal government will not repatriate the Australian families with links to Islamic State fighters who remain in Syria.

items.title: Live: Weather plays havoc on day 11, with aerials, slopestyle final postponed
items.description: Heavy snow has played havoc with the Winter Olympic schedule on day 11, with the women's slopestyle and men's and women's aerials events postponed. Follow live.

items.title: Civil rights leader Jesse Jackson dies, aged 84
items.description: The two-time Democratic presidential hopeful remembered for powerful speeches died peacefully surrounded by loved ones, his family said.

items.title: ASIC announces review into 'lead generators' pushing super switching
items.description: ASIC is investigating whether lead generators are complying with their legal obligations when suggesting people switch their retirement savings into less-regulated investment schemes.

items.title: Former NRL player’s mother speaks of 'seeking justice' over son's death
items.description: The mother of Manly player Keith Titmuss, who died of exertional heat stroke following a 2020 Sea Eagles training session, breaks her silence on her family's multi-million-dollar lawsuit against the NRL club.

items.title: 'Humiliating' anti-homeless devices under city bridge switched off
items.description: High-pitched noise devices installed under a bridge to deter rough sleepers are labelled "unnecessary" and "humiliating" by housing campaigners and condemned by the WA government.

items.title: Man who allegedly threw homemade bomb into Invasion Day rally crowd named
items.description: The man accused of throwing a bomb at Invasion Day protesters in an alleged terrorism act attack in Perth can be named as Liam Alexander Hall.

items.title: Police scour outhouse, water tank in Gus search
items.description: SA police said they have inspected an outhouse where cement has recently been laid and a water tank as part of the latest search for Gus Lamont in South Australia's Mid North, with no evidence so far.

items.title: Production company's closure is 'end of remarkable chapter' for Aussie TV
items.description: Matchbox Pictures, the local production house behind Dog Park, The Survivors and Secret City, will be closed by its international parent company, Universal International Studios.

items.title: Family of abducted 85yo say they are 'living through a nightmare'
items.description: The family of Sydney man Chris Baghsarian, who was abducted in a case of mistaken identity four days ago, are awaiting "some form of closure or resolution".

items.title: Are discounts fair dinkum? Coles' 'Down Down' pricing in the spotlight
items.description: Coles downplays what shoppers understood when they saw its "Down Down" price tags, saying "not much", on the second day of a bombshell federal court case.

items.title: Iran launches military drill as US deploys aircraft carrier on eve of nuclear talks
items.description: Representatives from the two nations are set to meet in Geneva on Tuesday, local time, as US President Donald Trump tries to curb Tehran's nuclear program.

items.title: 'Once-in-a-lifetime' red-rock waterfall in WA's north delights onlookers
items.description: The question of whether there is water in Python Pool is often asked around the pubs and message boards of WA's Pilbara. For the moment, the answer is very much yes.

items.title: French authorities intercept third cocaine shipment, bringing Pacific drug haul to $2.4bn
items.description: French authorities seized a 2.4-tonne drug shipment near French Polynesia during a joint operation with the United States.

items.title: Crews race to contain central Victorian bushfire ahead of wind change
items.description: The fire at Trawool, south of Seymour, broke out near the Goulburn Valley Highway in central Victoria on a day when half the state was facing extreme fire danger.

items.title: Fire crews battle blaze south of Launceston
items.description: The Tasmania Fire Service has downgraded an emergency bushfire warning for an area south of Launceston, with helicopters and ground crews in attendance.

items.title: How a single Louvre ticket complaint led to the bust of a $16m scam ring
items.description: Foreign tour guides and staff who were paid to remain silent orchestrated a counterfeit ticketing ring that robbed the Louvre of millions over more than a decade, Parisian prosecutors say.

items.title: 'Too shattering for language': Former ACT commissioner alleges sexual assault
items.description: Vanessa Turnbull-Roberts says she stepped down as the ACT's first Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children and young people commissioner to prioritise her safety after being subjected to sexual harassment and sexual assault by a public servant.

items.title: Woman shares insight into harrowing childhood in Queensland's state care
items.description: A Queensland woman whose adolescence was marred by sexual abuse and exploitation has described her experiences in residential care to Queensland's Child Safety Commission of Inquiry.

items.title: ABC Adelaide to move to new arts hub in CBD
items.description: The ABC has announced a new location for its Adelaide operations, moving to a new arts and media hub alongside other government arts organisation in the CBD.

items.title: Mobil agrees to pay $16 million fine for false fuel claims
items.description: The ACCC said Mobil advertised its Mobil Synergy fuel but did not actually supply the product at the time.
